fields.caption_bottom: Write a 929-bar LilyPond symphony without 35 billion Opus tokens

narrative_summary: The joke frames the symphony’s 35-billion-token refinement process as the real difficulty of composing 929 bars.
rationale: Candidate 3 has the cleanest reversal: the familiar impossible-task setup lands on the absurd 35-billion-token requirement while retaining the story’s strongest specifics. Candidate 4 supplies more data but reads as a fact list rather than a punchline.
story_title: Spending 35B Opus 5.5 Tokens to Write a Symphony
place: in a courtroom where the AI judge keeps citing hallucinated laws
hat_pair: giant foam CPU chip worn flat as a hat with heat sink fins poking up
